variantLabel.value: Variant 1 of 2: canonical keys for positional and keyword arguments

statement.value: FunctionCallCache(capacity) starts empty with room for capacity entries. call(functionName, args, kwargs) looks up the call identified by functionName, the positional argument list args and the keyword object kwargs. Argument values are JSON values: null, booleans, integers, strings, lists and objects with string keys. Two values are the same when they have the same type and equal contents: true differs from 1, 1 differs from "1", lists compare in order, objects compare as key sets with equal values regardless of key order. Two calls are the same when their names are equal, their args lists are the same and their kwargs objects are the same. On a hit the entry becomes the most recently used and call returns true; on a miss the call is inserted as the most recently used entry, the least recently used entry is evicted first when the cache is full, and call returns false. Every method call is answered in call order on one instance; void methods return nothing.
